We need to produce plan, not ask follow-up. So we must create plausible itinerary.

Day 2 March 24: Charlotte activities, maybe museum, park. Stay Charlotte.

Day 3 March 25: Travel from Charlotte to Asheville (flight? maybe drive). Transportation: drive rental car. Breakfast maybe in Charlotte. Attractions in Asheville. Accommodation.

Day 4 March 26: Asheville attractions.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"
